name: meter-fleet
description: Meter for Drivers & Fleets, the taxi meter and fleet platform for AI agents. Ask about a fleet's trips, bookings, drivers, vehicles, earnings and accounting, see a driver's own trips and pay stubs, guide a new fleet through onboarding, and change settings with a dry run and your confirmation. Signs in with your Meter account in the browser.

interface.shortDescription: Drive or run a taxi fleet
interface.longDescription: Meter is the taxi meter and fleet platform: drivers run a meter in the Meter app, and fleets manage drivers, vehicles, fares, scheduled bookings and money. This plugin connects your agent to the hosted Meter for Drivers & Fleets MCP server with your own Meter sign-in, so it sees exactly what you see. Fleet owners get answers about trips, bookings, drivers, vehicles, earnings and accounting, a guided onboarding, and settings changes that apply only after a dry run and their confirmation. Drivers see their own trips and pay stubs and update their own availability and profile.
defaultPrompt: How much did my fleet earn last week, and which driver had the most trips?
Which bookings are still unassigned for tomorrow morning?
Show me my own trips and card payouts for last week.
